Do I feel guilty after correcting a student?
Yes. I do.
People often think teachers can easily move on after correcting a student, but the truth is, some of us carry those moments with us. After class, we find ourselves thinking, Was I too harsh? Did I embarrass the student? Could I have handled it differently?
